subject: Oceanography
title: Why Oceans Matter
description: A quick, practical guide to Why Oceans Matter.

hook.text: The ocean produces over 50% of Earth's oxygen—more than all rainforests combined.

buildup.text: Tiny phytoplankton in the surface waters generate this oxygen through photosynthesis.

discovery.text: Oceans also absorb about 30% of human CO₂ emissions, slowing climate change.

twist.text: But absorbing CO₂ makes seawater more acidic—threatening coral reefs and shellfish.

climax.text: The ocean regulates temperature, drives weather, feeds billions, and stores vast carbon.

punchline.text: Every second breath you take comes from the ocean.

quiz.question: What percentage of Earth's oxygen does the ocean produce?
